notes.title: Air : 1.03.09032020 update!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone ![/b]

Before this update you have the possibility to change every key to control your small paper plane.
With the keyboard or with an XBox360 controller, you can change any keys, but is not exactly true for the joysticks. You have the possibility to inverse the control of your paper plane with the keyboard and the cross of the gamepad only.

If you use the joystick to control your small paper plane, the game takes automatically the rotation of your joysticks to apply the movement to your plane. 
[i](Up to Up, Down to Down, etc...)[/i]

Now you have two new options in the menu of the game to change that.
You have the possibility to inverse the Up with the Down, the Left with the Right or both
[i](Up to Down, Down to Up, etc...)[/i]

These new options are automatically deactivated when you launch the game for the first time. 
But you can at any time change these options.

This new update resets your options configuration file when you launch the game for the first time. And these new options are translated in all languages available for the game.

Have fun!

notes.title: Air : 1.02.091219 update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35927758/47045140968df1d1b12f95c7d962f50265b380d2.jpg[/img]
[b]
Hello everyone !

A new update is available for Air![/b]
This update correct few many issues, increase the game performance and change or add many functionalities of the game.


[h1]Game performance :[/h1]
- I have merged many shaders to increase the game performance. With this merge, the graphic card is less use.
- All textures of the game was resized to optimise the game without to change the graphic quality. With this change, the game is loading more quicker and he use less memory.[i](2.4go before the update and now 1.4go)[/i]
- All shadows are now with a less resolution to increase the game performance. But the shadows are more smooth in order to make this change invisible.
- I have deleted the HDR shader because the HDR (High dynamic range) shader embedded in the game engine is more powerful.
- I have deleted the motion blur shader. Not very visible in the game and he uses too many resources.


[h1]Game render :[/h1]
- To improve the game render, the draw lines are more smoothed of the toon shader to delete the pixel effect of this shader render.
- The sharpness and chromatic aberration shaders are less strong.
- The color saturation of the game changes a little bit.


[h1]Game functionnalities :[/h1]
- With the Xbox game controller, only the A key is available now to select a menu like it is indicated in the help interface. Before all keys could be useful and can be make a conflict with other keys.
- Now in the interface of the game you can change the selected menu with the directional cross or with the joystick. Before you could choose the menu only with the joystick.
- A report log was added. This file is available in the Air folder of steam at the .txt format. After a new game session is launched, the file information is deleted to save the new information about your current game session. If you have a crash of the game, copy all file information in the forum of Air and explain your game crash in order to help me to solve this issue. Thank you.
 

[h1]Bug corrections :[/h1]
- In the some levels, the shadows can appear very near of the player camera. This issue was solved.
- In the control options with the Xbox game controller, the game check immediately if you change a direction with your joystick to asign this new key to control your plane. Before this update, the game didn't check or where he was taking a very long time to check the new control.
- Solving a problem that would not correctly display the interface after a crash with your paper plane. No way for the player to restart the level or quit the game.
- Solving a problem that would not correctly display the interface to change the level when you arrived at the end of a level.
- Solving a problem that to not recorded correctly your position in the world when you passed a waypoint.

notes.title: Air : 1.01.261119 patch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35927758/22faa03a3d192894ec3b5bd1c7c817727c122a74.jpg[/img]

[b]Hellow everyone !

A new patch is now available for Air ![/b]

This patch is very important and allow to solve the problem of latency of the game.
For example, if you play the game with 30 frames per seconds (fps) the speed rate of the game will be divided by 2. All actors of the game (plane, cars, birds, ...) have her speed divided by 2.

To solve this issue, every actors script has been changed.
Now if you play with 30 or 60 frames per seconds or less, the game run with the same speed.

notes.title: Air : 1.01 update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35927758/30118912a6b6874b17f917b0c83caeacaa6ddb09.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello everyone ![/b]

[h1]The update 1.01 for Air is now available![/h1]
[b]This update solves many problems of compatibility system and loss of performance.[/b]

- [b]The video of the logo "Calepin Studio" when you launch the game was deleted.[/b] This video could do crash the game or lose many frames per seconds.

-[b] A new load screen was added[/b] when you launch the game. The window of the game doesn't appear in black anymore.

- [b]A new video introduction[/b] for the logo "Calepin Studio" and the game were added to replace the old video logo after the new load screen when you launch the game.

- [b]A new check system was added[/b] in the launcher window of the game to prevent any crash due to of a change or problem of an any option in your options files.

- [b]A new option was added in the options of the game[/b] (not in the launcher). This option allows you to activate or not the "shaders" of the game independently of the graphic quality that you have chosen.

[i]The "Shaders" is all effects compute by the graphic card like for example the chromatic aberration, the saturation of the color, ambient occlusion or the toon effect.[/i]

This deactivation of the shaders allows you to increase the performance of the game if you have a very small computer configuration for example. But the quality of the game change.

However the principal function of this shader option is to increase the compatibility of the game to all the graphics cards (ATI or Nvidia). Because some shaders can make a conflict with some graphics cards and create a crash of your game.

If your game crash or you have an important loss of performance when you launch a new game, deactivate the shaders. Which will allow you to play the game. 

[b]But if your problem persist, do not hesitate to contact me[/b] on the forum on Steam or by the mail adress on the Calepin Studio web site : 
http://www.calepinstudio.com/index.php?page=contact
